answer: The quartz lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pearl is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing.
